Klasse Stroke

java.lang.Object
treptowkolleg.plot.Stroke
public abstract class Stroke extends Object
A collection of predefined BasicStroke instances for consistent and semantic line styling in plot rendering. Each constant is named according to its visual weight and intended use (e.g., axes, grid, data curves).

    • BEVEL_MEDIUM

      public static final BasicStroke BEVEL_MEDIUM
      Medium-weight beveled stroke for general-purpose lines such as data curves. Width: 2.0 pixels; beveled joins; butt caps.

    • GRID_FINE

      public static final BasicStroke GRID_FINE
      Thin stroke for fine grid lines. Width: 0.5 pixels; miter joins; butt caps.

    • AXIS_MEDIUM

      public static final BasicStroke AXIS_MEDIUM
      Medium-weight stroke for main coordinate axes (x and y). Width: 1.5 pixels; miter joins; butt caps.

    • AXIS_THICK

      public static final BasicStroke AXIS_THICK
      Thick stroke for emphasized axes or zero-reference lines. Width: 2.5 pixels; miter joins; butt caps.

    • GRID_DASHED

      public static final BasicStroke GRID_DASHED
      Dashed stroke for grid lines that should be visually subtle. Width: 0.75 pixels; dash pattern [5, 5]; miter joins; butt caps.

    • GUIDE_THIN

      public static final BasicStroke GUIDE_THIN
      Very thin stroke for delicate guide or helper lines. Width: 0.25 pixels; miter joins; butt caps.

    • LINE_THICK

      public static final BasicStroke LINE_THICK
      Thick, rounded stroke for prominent or highlighted curves. Width: 3.0 pixels; rounded caps and joins for smooth appearance.

    • LINE_DASHED

      public static final BasicStroke LINE_DASHED
      Dashed stroke for secondary or auxiliary curves. Width: 2.0 pixels; dash pattern [10, 5]; miter joins; butt caps.

    • DOTTED

      public static final BasicStroke DOTTED
      Dotted stroke for subtle reference or helper lines. Width: 1.0 pixel; dot pattern [1, 3]; rounded caps and joins.
